spiritgiven.comments: Thanks for the game, the communication both on and off the field and of course hosting this WJUC :)
We loved your energy and that you didn‘t stop playing your best frisbee throughout the game! :) <3
Thanks for this fun game and for implementing our feedback from the pre circle :))
We love your energy, great communication, fair mindedness and that you’re so overall lovely people!
What an intense and fair game, thank you!
Your positive attitude throughout the game was amazing as well as how you fought for every disc! And we had an amazing time with you on the sideline :)
What a fun and well fought game, thanks a lot!
Thank you Japan for this hard fought game! You are so incredibly quick both on the field and in your heads, which, combined with your friendly attitude, made this game a highlight :)

Thank you for this very intense and fun last game! For the next time we’d appreciate calls being made on the field and not from the sideline as well as sticking to the time limits (that’s why 1 on rules knowledge and use), but we loved your power and loud sideline even though it was the last game. Congratulations and see you next year at Europeans :))

spiritreceived.comments: Lovely match, always respetcfull and kind!
Thank you for the really lovely game, and taking care of our players as well as your own :)

there were instances where rules when players were unsure of rules but also instances when rules were made clear to some of my teammates - appreciative of that! There were also moments when we shared different perspectives during the game but we managed to settle them honestly and cordially. Good luck for the rest of your games:-)
Good game. Great speed, deep shots and pulls. Good luck in your next matches!
Fun game, thanks for the intensity all the way until the end!
There were a praise when both team scored and we did fist bumps a lot so it was such a spirited game! Thank you for the good game! Good luck in the next and the last game!!
A very intense last game and any contact was mutual and communication was great. Just be careful on how you set your defense as it caused loads of picks.
